ValidationRule.description: This rule is to prevent users from editing Order record except Integration User and System Administrator.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( NOT($Setup.PMC_ProcessSwitches__c.PMC_BypassValidationRule__c), AND( NOT($Profile.Name = "System Administrator"), NOT($Profile.Name = "API Only profile"), NOT($Profile.Name = "Salesforce API Only System Integrations"), NOT(CONTAINS( LOWER($Profile.Name), "digital hub")), NOT(CONTAINS( LOWER($Profile.Name), "partner community")) ), NOT(ISNEW()) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: This Order has been placed and is therefore locked from further modifications. Any updates from SAP will be reflected here.
